sh: Ukraine hits Crimea bridge; Kyiv bridges struck
headline: Ukraine collapses part of the bridge to Crimea as Russian strikes damage bridges in Kyiv
summary: A Ukrainian strike brought down part of the Kerch Bridge, which links Russia to occupied Crimea, on the night of 16 to 17 November. The same night, Russian missiles hit two main bridges in Kyiv, Ukrainian officials said.
why: The Kerch Bridge is a key supply route for Russian troops and a symbol of Russia’s control of Crimea. The attacks come two days before Putin is due to meet Trump and Xi in Shenzhen, where the war may be discussed.

event.t: Ukraine attacked the Kerch Bridge for the second night in a row. Images checked by NBC News show a section of the road bridge collapsed into the water.
Ukraine’s President Volodymyr Zelensky confirmed the attack and called it unprecedented.
Traffic on the bridge was stopped. Crimea’s Russian-installed leader, Sergei Aksyonov, said a Ukrainian drone attack near Kerch killed two people.

In Kyiv, Mayor Vitali Klitschko said Russian missiles hit the city’s Northern and Southern bridges over the Dnipro. City officials reported one person injured, and some districts lost water and heating.

effects.label: Russian supply lines
effects.t: Road traffic to Crimea over the bridge is stopped.

effects.label: Kyiv residents
effects.t: Two main river crossings in the capital are closed for repairs.

updates.t: Russian officials called the strike a terrorist act and said a plan to repair the bridge will be drawn up, CNN and NBC News report. Russia said it shot down 1,441 Ukrainian drones overnight, a record, ABC News and NPR report.

Overnight, Ukrainian drones caused fires at two industrial sites in Russia’s Krasnodar region, which local reports name as the Afipsky and Ilsky oil refineries. Regional officials said four people were injured.

corrections.t: 18 Nov 2026: an earlier version said Russian attacks killed two people in Kyiv. Kyiv officials reported one person injured there.
